title: Giant Tree's Orbital Engine: A Megastructure Above the Canopy
seo_description:
Explore the Giant Tree's impossible orbital engine, a mountain-scale megastructure designed to maintain a living canopy without cutting branches. This cinematic AI vision imagines a giant tree transformed into a futuristic ecosystem with gravity control, robotic maintenance systems, and advanced botanical engineering.

Watch as the Canopy Orbit Engine rotates around the crown, balancing sunlight, airflow, humidity, and habitat through precision technology. A futuristic take on giant trees, ancient forests, and the future of environmental engineering.
